digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text rendering harness and inbound echo-suppression
propositions: Live DC rendered HTML must be verified via ?expand=renderedFields assertions (bold/heading/code-macro), not just wiki source
State-based echo-safety requires that a converged body re-read from the live Jira instance triggers no inbound description change on the second pass

Concurrent both-sides edits (rebar-side AND Jira-side to description before next pass) must keep the local (rebar) body as the winner and emit a deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with the remote value recorded
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must maintain a stable contract signature and behavior to prevent breaking the agentic-dev-platform import
Inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression by comparing Jira's value against the local body's landed wire form (map_fields_to_remote), mirroring the outbound _baseline_form_matches logic

The rendered-HTML test must enable REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc to activate the DC cutover codec and use literal {code} macros (not fenced blocks) so the live Jira renderer produces code panels
